> PUBLIC REPOSITORY: All issue text, edit history, attachments and links may be visible to anyone. Only post non-sensitive information.
>
> Never include usernames linked to private services, internal service or webhook URLs, tokens, signing secrets, OAuth client identifiers, private installation IDs, customer information, or credentials.
> Use `********` for any private identifiers and `https://example.invalid/webhooks/example` for sample URLs. Masking is not encryption.
